dash.title: Dashboard
dash.desc: Plays, certification, review status, and your to-dos at a glance.
dash.settleDesc: {plays} counted plays so far · 70% to the partner (store pool split by 30s+ store play time · direct sales and licenses accrue directly · paid after withholding tax · finalized each cycle)
dash.recentEmptyDesc: Upload a track made on a paid commercial plan.

create.title: AI generation
create.desc: Request music generations and track their status. Daily quota and banned-prompt filters apply.
create.emptyDesc: Enter a prompt to request your first AI track.
create.backendDown: The music generation server is unreachable. Ask an admin to connect it.
create.modalDesc: Enter a prompt and optional lyrics to queue a generation.
create.fPromptPh: E.g. calm piano and strings cinematic intro, 90 BPM

v2.panelDesc: A preview ahead of our own generative model launch. Requests join the existing generation queue.
v2.promptPh: E.g. a calm cinematic intro with piano and strings, 90 BPM
v2.promptHint: Up to 2000 characters. Real-artist mimicry and voice-clone requests are blocked.
v2.seedPh: E.g. 42 — the same seed reproduces the result
v2.variationEmpty: Request a generation and the first variation shows here.
v2.variationSoon: The second variation ships at launch.

upload.title: AI track upload
upload.desc: Only AI tracks that pass the commercial-use verification can be registered.
upload.s1Desc: Choose a lossless WAV, FLAC, or 192k+ MP3.
upload.s2Desc: Verifies the AI platform, plan, and generation date used to make the track.
upload.s3Desc: Enter track details and the AI creation scope.
upload.creditTitle: AI creation scope (select all that apply)
upload.contribDesc: Supports copyright registration and disputes, and is recorded in the certification snapshot.
upload.fContribDescPh: Original lyrics, mastering EQ, vocal guide, …
upload.trustedBlock: Society-entrusted works cannot be accepted until a royalty settlement path exists. Confirm non-entrustment and resubmit.
upload.s4Desc: Review your entries, accept the required warranties, then submit.
upload.wOwn: [Ownership] I warrant that I am the lawful rightsholder and that this track was created and downloaded by me within a valid subscription to a paid plan that allows standalone streaming distribution.
upload.wNoRetro: [No free-tier retroactivity] I warrant this is not a free-tier creation retroactively covered by a later paid upgrade.
upload.wNoClone: [No voice cloning or sampling] I warrant no unauthorized voice replication or plagiarism of existing works.
upload.wIndemnify: [Indemnity and false-filing sanctions] I agree to indemnify the platform for false statements and to forfeiture of resulting revenue.
upload.submitDone: Track registered. It goes live after admin approval.
upload.blockBase: The selected plan or generation-time track can't be distributed as commercial standalone streaming, so it can't be uploaded.
upload.blockBasePlan: The selected plan ({plan}) or generation-time track can't be distributed as commercial standalone streaming, so it can't be uploaded.
upload.blockRetro: Generation predates the paid subscription (no retroactive cover): {code}
upload.blockExpired: Generated after the paid subscription expired: {code}
upload.stagedDone: Staging upload done. Integrity/format checks run at finalize.
upload.discFull: FULL_AI: this track was fully generated by AI.
upload.discAssist: AI_ASSISTED_HUMAN: made by a human creator with AI assist tools.

catalog.title: My tracks
catalog.desc: Review status and certificates for your tracks. Click a row for the review timeline.

proofs.title: AI subscription proofs
proofs.desc: Register paid commercial-plan receipts; uploads unlock after admin verification.
proofs.emptyDesc: Register a paid commercial subscription invoice.
proofs.modalTitle: Register a paid AI subscription proof
proofs.modalDesc: Enter the commercial-plan invoice or receipt details.
proofs.created: Proof registered. It activates after admin verification.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.desc: Play performance and the settlement basis. Payouts finalize each settlement cycle.
earnings.ruleDesc: The store pool splits by 30s+ store play time; direct sales and licenses accrue to the partner directly, then withholding tax is deducted.
earnings.ruleNote: General streaming plays create no payout.

settings.title: Studio settings
settings.desc: Manage your artist name, creator address, and payout account.
settings.nameDesc: The creator name shown on tracks.
settings.handleDesc: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores, 3–30 chars. Becomes your creator page address.
settings.payoutDesc: Where payouts are sent. Stored encrypted.
